title: Nucleation of the destruction complex on the centrosome accelerates degradation of beta-catenin and regulates Wnt signal transmission.
authors: Lach, Ryan S; Qiu, Chongxu; Kajbaf, Erfan Zeyaei; Baxter, Naomi; Han, Dasol; Wang, Alex; Lock, Hannah; Chirikian, Orlando; Pruitt, Beth; Wilson, Maxwell Z
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wnt信号通路中破坏复合物在中心体上的液-液相分离与β-catenin降解，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且方法为细胞成像与有限元模拟，与课题无关。
abstract: Wnt signal transduction is controlled by the destruction complex (DC), a condensate comprising scaffold proteins and kinases that regulate beta-catenin stability. Overexpressed DC scaffolds undergo liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), but DC mesoscale organization at endogenous expression levels and its role in beta-catenin processing were previously unknown. Here, we find that DC LLPS is nucleated by the centrosome. Through a combination of CRISPR-engineered custom fluorescent tags, finite element simulations, and optogenetic tools that allow for manipulation of DC concentration and multivalency, we find that centrosomal nucleation drives processing of beta-catenin by colocalizing DC components to a single reaction crucible. Enriching GSK3beta partitioning on the centrosome controls beta-catenin processing and prevents Wnt-driven embryonic stem cell differentiation to mesoderm. Our findings demonstrate the role of nucleators in controlling biomolecular condensates and suggest tight integration between Wnt signal transduction and the cell cycle.
abstract_zh: Wnt信号转导由破坏复合体（DC）控制，这是一种包含支架蛋白和激酶的凝聚体，调节β-catenin稳定性。过表达的DC支架蛋白经历液-液相分离（LLPS），但内源表达水平下DC的中尺度组织及其在β-catenin加工中的作用此前未知。在此，我们发现DC LLPS由中心体引发。通过结合CRISPR工程化定制荧光标签、有限元模拟以及允许操纵DC浓度和多价性的光遗传学工具，我们发现中心体成核通过将DC组分共定位到单一反应熔炉中驱动β-catenin加工。富集中心体上的GSK3beta分配控制β-catenin加工，并阻止Wnt驱动的胚胎干细胞向中胚层分化。我们的发现证明了成核因子在控制生物分子凝聚体中的作用，并提示Wnt信号转导与细胞周期之间存在紧密整合。
